config.style: stone cottage: slate stone walls, dark pitched gable roof with ridge cap, exterior cobblestone chimney past ridge, cream-trimmed shuttered windows x3, 7-stud wood door with step

steps: Frame-diffed viewport health check via capture (live)
get_references('stone cottage house') x3 - noted pitched gable roof, stone walls, chimney past ridge, cream trim/shutters
Assembled 53-part Model at (-150,250) on clear ground: segmented walls with real door/window openings, wedge gables, pitched roof slabs, chimney, trim
First capture_angles showed inverted roof pitch + arena occlusion - rebuilt at clear coordinates with corrected wedge/slab orientation
Re-captured front/back/left/iso - all angles read as cottage vs references

recipe.text: Recipe: segment each wall around openings (sill+header parts) instead of boolean cuts; door opening 4w x 7h. Gables = two wedges per end, vertical faces toward ridge (yaw 180 on the +Z half). Roof = two slabs rotated CFrame.Angles(side*atan2(rise,halfW),0,0) centered at z = center +/- halfW/2, overhang +3 long/+2 slope. Chimney outside the gable wall, height H+rise+3 so it clears the ridge. First placement collided with SiegeArena bounding box - probe big occupiers' bounds first and site on genuinely clear ground.
